messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up from the P-310 postmortem (kv-cache thrash). We need clear owners + timelines for remediation, and concrete runbook/playbook edits for triage & escalation. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/p-310 :link:

miguel: I can own the cache tuning work (params + batching). Plan: reproduce in staging this week, change defaults, smoke test, then prod deploy canary. ETA Tue EOD for staging repro, Thu for canary. :thumbsup:

ashley: I will take the runbook edits. Need the exact commands and a short checklist to add to the triage section. Question: should we add a quick `kubectl` snippet or keep it higher level?

dena: Add escalation path to Dedicated capacity team if eviction rate > 10% for 5m. Oncall should page SRE then Dedicated lead. Also add instruction to fallback to model variant `redwood-small` if tail latency > 500ms.

oncall-bot: Current oncall: SRE: @ashley (today) · Paging policy applied for P1 incidents (escalate after 10m if no ack).

miguel: Proposed runbook snippet to add under "triage -> cache thrash":

```
# check eviction rate
kubectl exec -it $(kubectl get pod -l app=kv-cache -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -- sh -c "curl -s http://localhost/metrics | grep eviction_rate"

# temporarily increase cache size and disable aggressive eviction
kubectl patch cm cache-config -p '{"data":{"max_entries":"200000"}}'
```

ashley: Perfect, I'll paste that in and add a one-line 'rollback' section. I can do an initial PR and tag @miguel and @dena for review. Targeting Fri AM for the runbook PR.

dena: Also: create an alert on `cache_eviction_rate` with two levels: warn @channel at 2x baseline, page @sre at 5x baseline. Add note on recurring incidents: if same alert fires 3x in 2 weeks, trigger a retro + permanent config change.

frank: Good. I'll own the follow-up cadence. Proposal: weekly 30m check-in for owners until actions are closed, roll into ops retro if recurring. I'll set a recurring calendar and invite owners.

elaine: Summary of agreed owners & timelines:
- miguel: cache tuning & prod canary (staging repro by Tue EOD, prod canary Thu)
- ashley: runbook + playbook edits (PR by Fri AM)
- dena: alert thresholds + recurring-incident rule (PR by Wed)
- frank: weekly check-in owner (recurring invite today)

Action items for runbook edits to include: triage commands (see snippet), rollback steps, explicit escalation path to Dedicated, alert thresholds, and a note to evaluate model fallback `redwood-small` for degraded latency. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you accept. I'll close this thread once PR links are posted.
